# Travaholic

> Travaholic is an Indian D2C brand that makes premium trucker caps, each one inspired by a real place or journey. Flat pricing at ₹1,399 per cap, ships across India.

Travaholic sells trucker caps grouped into themed Story Series (e.g. Blue Horizon, Into The Wild, Summer Escape, Urban Nomad, Desert Trails, Above The Clouds), with individual cap designs called Chapters: Travaholic Black, Travaholic Ocean, Travaholic Sky, Beach'n, Sunshine, Tropical Blue, Tropical Pink, Dunes Maroon, Dunes Yellow, Peaking, Travaholic Snow, Wildling, Junglee, City Slicker, City Slicker Black, Travaholic Orange.

All caps are priced at ₹1,399 (inclusive of GST). Orders ship across India via Shiprocket, typically arriving in 4-7 business days. Returns and exchanges are accepted within 7 days of delivery for unused items with tags attached.

Travaholic also runs a loyalty program called Travaholic Miles, earned on every purchase and redeemable for discounts on future orders.

## Key Pages

- [Collection](https://travaholic.in/series): Browse all Story Series and Chapters.
- [About](https://travaholic.in/about): The brand's founder story.
- [Journal](https://travaholic.in/journal): Travel stories and editorial content tied to the Collection.
- [Shipping Policy](https://travaholic.in/shipping-policy): Delivery areas, timelines, and live pincode-based shipping cost.
- [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://travaholic.in/refund-policy): Return window and process.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://travaholic.in/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://travaholic.in/privacy)
